title: C2 Milestone 6
completion_message: ¡Magistral! Has superado el Milestone 6. Tu dominio de la retórica avanzada, el 'Corporate Doublespeak', los phrasal verbs financieros y las cláusulas de participio es digno de un CEO de una compañía Fortune 500.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes: 

1. Phrasal Verbs in High Finance: 
- Bail out (rescatar), Write off (dar por perdido), Cash in on (lucrarse), Prop up (apuntalar). 

2. Euphemisms & Corporate Doublespeak: 
- Let go (despedir), Right-sizing (recortes), Collateral damage, Negative growth.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 6, Executive Synthesis. This exam will test your mastery of the recent lessons. First, Phrasal Verbs in High Finance, including terms like bail out, write off, cash in on, and prop up. Second, Euphemisms and Corporate Doublespeak, such as let go, right-sizing, collateral damage, and negative growth.

parts.visual:
3. Participle Clauses para eficiencia: 
- Having reviewed the report (Perfect). 
- Realizing the danger (Present). 
- Driven by ambition (Past). 
- Not knowing what to do (Negative). 

4. Corporate Diplomacy (Hedging & Softening): 
- It appears to be... 
- I'm not entirely convinced... 
- With all due respect... 
- We might want to consider...
parts.audio: Third, Participle Clauses for writing efficiency. Like: Having reviewed the report, Realizing the danger, Driven by ambition, and Not knowing what to do. Finally, Corporate Diplomacy, focusing on Hedging and Softening. Phrases like: It appears to be, I'm not entirely convinced, With all due respect, and We might want to consider. Good luck!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio ejecutivo en este examen de consolidación.

questions.question: Instead of saying 'we are firing 200 people', the PR department called it a ____ initiative.
questions.explanation: Right-sizing = eufemismo para recortes de personal.

questions.question: During the crisis, the central bank had to ____ several major institutions to prevent an economic crash. (Rescatar financieramente).
Because she hadn't received the email, she missed the meeting. -> ____ the email, she missed the meeting.
questions.explanation: Not having received (Participle Clause negativa y perfecta).

questions.question: Direct: You made a massive mistake here. -> Diplomatic: It ____ to be a slight oversight here.
questions.explanation: It appears to be = parece ser.

questions.question: The board decided to ____ the CEO's bonus after discovering the fraud. (Recuperar lo pagado).
Because it was built in 1950, the facility needs modernizing. -> ____ in 1950, the facility needs modernizing.
The company didn't report a $10M loss; they reported $10M of '____ growth'.
Direct: Change the entire plan. -> Diplomatic: We might want to ____ revising the plan.
questions.explanation: We might want to consider = podríamos querer considerar.

questions.question: Many speculators tried to ____ the housing crisis by buying properties cheaply. (Sacar provecho de).
questions.explanation: Cash in on = lucrarse de una oportunidad.

questions.question: Because he knew the market was volatile, he didn't invest. -> ____ the market was volatile, he didn't invest.
Direct: I strongly disagree. -> Diplomatic: I'm not entirely ____ that this will work.
questions.explanation: I'm not entirely convinced = no estoy del todo convencido.

questions.question: The debt is uncollectible, so the bank will just have to ____ it off as a loss.
Instead of saying 'You are fired', the manager said 'We are letting you ____'.
After they had signed the contract, they ordered dinner. -> ____ the contract, they ordered dinner.
The government is trying to ____ the struggling auto industry with subsidies. (Apuntalar/Sostener).
Small local businesses were just ____ damage in the war between the corporate giants.
Direct: Send me the report now. -> Diplomatic: I was ____ if you could send me the report.
questions.explanation: I was wondering if = me preguntaba si...

questions.question: Instead of calling it a 'bribe' (soborno), they called it a '____ payment'.
Direct: I hate this. -> Diplomatic: I'm not a ____ fan of this approach.
The politician wasn't technically lying, he was just being '____ with the truth'.
questions.explanation: Economical with the truth = eufemismo británico para mentir u ocultar.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra o phrasal verb clave.

questions.question: To ____ out the banks. (Rescatar con B)
Right-____. (Recortes de personal con S)
Because he signed -> ____ signed, he left. (Perfect Participle)
It ____ to be a mistake. (Parece con A)
To ____ off a debt. (Dar por perdido con W)
____ damage. (Daño colateral con C)
Because it was built -> ____ in 1990... (Pasiva)
I'm not entirely ____. (Convencido con C)
To cash in ____ the trend. (Lucrarse de)
With all ____ respect. (Debido con D)
